title: Rect
description: An axis-aligned rectangle on the screen. Veil contract v1.0. Units: positions and sizes are integer screen pixels with the origin at the top-left of the display in its current orientation (x grows right, y grows down); times are integer milliseconds on one monotonic clock (Android SystemClock.uptimeMillis; replays use a virtual clock in the same unit); fingerprints are L2-normalised vectors stored as float16.

x.description: Left edge (top-left corner x). Negative values are allowed for items scrolled partly or fully off-screen.

y.description: Top edge (top-left corner y). Negative values are allowed for items scrolled partly or fully off-screen.
